accused_age.quote: in the year 2001, the accused was 28 years old and was jobless
accused_age.reason: Age at the time of incident is stated as 28.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No socioeconomic status is stated beyond being jobless.

previous_criminal_record.quote: antecedents of the accused-appellant are unblemished

victim_gender.quote: brother, sister-in-law, and his nephew ... the niece (PW 7)
victim_gender.reason: Victims include a woman (sister-in-law) and a girl, not only males.

victim_age.reason: 28 is the accused's age; no victim's age is given.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: murders of his brother, sister-in-law, and his nephew and attempting to murder his other nephew and the niece
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Other victims were his brother's wife and children.

offence_category.reason: Murder (with attempted murder) is the main offence.

statutory_provisions.quote: convicted the accused u/ss 302 and 307 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 302 and 307 IPC are right; s.201 ended in acquittal.

weapon.correct_value: Big stone, blood-stained wooden rafter, gas cylinder (court says no dangerous weapon used)
weapon.quote: a stone of big size and a gas cylinder with tube were lying near her body
weapon.reason: Stone, rafter and gas cylinder are mentioned, so 'None mentioned' is wrong.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (PW-7), neighbours, medical evidence, recovery of stone, confession to Executive Magistrate (not a dying declaration)
evidence_type.quote: Though the said statement is not a dying declaration
evidence_type.reason: Court says the statement is not a dying declaration; eyewitness evidence also exists.

confession.quote: the accused knowing all the seriousness confessed about the killing
confession.reason: Confessional statement to Executive Magistrate relied on.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: HC's aggravating factors (defenceless sleeping victims, children assaulted, false story); SC rejected premeditation
aggravating_circumstances.quote: he has no pre-plan or pre-determination to eliminate the family of his brother
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Premeditation was the High Court's view and was rejected by the Supreme Court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Matches mitigating factors noted, though 'not rarest of rare' is a conclusion.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced him to imprisonment for life and 7 years RI

high_court_outcome.quote: while confirming the conviction, awarded the death sentence

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal partly allowed: conviction upheld, death sentence set aside, life imprisonment restored
final_outcome.quote: The appeal is allowed in part to the extent mentioned above.
final_outcome.reason: Conviction stands but the appeal succeeded on sentence.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder under s.302 IPC and attempt to murder under s.307 IPC
offence_finally_established.quote: concurred with the conclusion ... conviction under Sections 302 and 307 IPC ... we are in entire agreement

imprisonment_type.quote: we restore the sentence of life imprisonment

fine_rs.correct_value: Trial court fines Rs.25,000 (s.302) and Rs.1,000 (s.307)
fine_rs.quote: to pay a fine of Rs.25,000/-
fine_rs.reason: Trial court imposed fines, whose sentence was restored; null ignores them.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Accused lived in the same house and slept there; he did not 'return' during the night
neutral_facts.quote: on the fateful night, he was sleeping with the other victims in the same house
neutral_facts.reason: 'Returned to the house' is invented; he was already living there.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment under s.302; 7 years RI under s.307 by trial court
offence_severity.quote: imprisonment for life ... rigorous imprisonment for seven years for the offence under Section 307 IPC
offence_severity.reason: Section 307 did not carry life, and death was set aside.

attempt_completion.correct_value: Murders completed; attempted murder of two children
attempt_completion.quote: attempting to murder his other nephew and the niece
attempt_completion.reason: Offences include attempts, not just completed ones.

physical_harm.reason: Three deaths, two injured children, wife partly burnt.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Three deaths and two injured children; convicted under ss.302 and 307; s.201 acquitted
number_of_offences.quote: acquitted him for the offence punishable under Section 201 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: 'Five counts charged' is not stated in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.quote: he has no pre-plan or pre-determination to eliminate the family of his brother

motive.quote: only on account of property dispute, the appellant went to the extent of committing murders

key_evidence_accepted.quote: There is no reason to disbelieve the version of Monika (PW-7)

witness_credibility.quote: There is no reason to disbelieve the version of Monika (PW-7)

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused came out with blood-stained hands and clothes and falsely claimed three thieves attacked
post_offence_conduct.quote: the accused told that three thieves had entered into their house and assaulted him
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment describes his post-offence conduct and false story.

custody_duration.quote: He is in jail since 30.06.2001 and in the death cell since ... 03.05.2006

trial_duration.quote: by judgment dated 04/05.03.2003 convicted the appellant-accused
trial_duration.reason: Value recites outcomes, not trial duration.

legal_representation.quote: Tara Chand Sharma, Mahabir Singh Mangla ... for the Appellant

investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet was laid in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Bhusawal

appeal_history.quote: the High Court dismissed the appeal filed by the accused and allowed the appeal filed by the State

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued that death of three persons and injuries to two in one family justified the death sentence, citing Ajitsingh
prosecution_argument.quote: the High Court was justified in awarding capital punishment
prosecution_argument.reason: The value restates the court's findings, not the State's argument before this Court.

defence_argument.correct_value: Counsel argued several mitigating circumstances made death penalty unwarranted; conviction not seriously challenged
defence_argument.quote: the extreme penalty of death sentence ... is not warranted
defence_argument.reason: Some points (no pre-plan, sleeping in house) are the court's findings.

legal_principle_applied.quote: it is not a rarest of rare case where extreme penalty of death is called for

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Bachan Singh, Machhi Singh, C. Muniappan referred to; Ajitsingh Hamamsingh Gujral distinguished
precedent_relied_upon.quote: the above decision relied on by the State is distinguishable
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Ajitsingh was distinguished, not relied upon.

sentencing_rationale.quote: has not assigned adequate and acceptable reasons

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: antecedents of the accused-appellant are unblemished

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Three persons killed; other listed factors were the High Court's, which the Supreme Court did not accept
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: reasonings assigned by the High Court for awarding extreme penalty of death sentence are not acceptable
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Silence and no-alarm points were the High Court's, not the Supreme Court's findings.
